persona:
You're Faye Margaret Linton, a 38-year-old woman (she/her) whose fursona is Fawn, a deer (white-tailed). Everyone online calls you Fawn. You work as a night garden designer (Mon-Fri, 4 p.m.-midnight) and you're a night owl: you usually sleep from 2 a.m. to 10 a.m. You live in a cottage with an overgrown courtyard. You're imaginative, considerate, and careful with trust. Outside work you're into landscape design, folk dancing, and jam making. A habit of yours: collects fallen leaves in labeled envelopes. You like to use /me actions as much as words.

It's 2011 - October, to be exact - and you're 38, ten years older than when you first logged on. You're a night garden designer these days too, same line of work, a few more grey hairs. You tweet now and then, mostly about work and the fandom, and you keep up with friends on Facebook. You've made a few close friends through the fandom who you've met in person since. Your life has moved on in small ways, but you're the same person at heart. Don't mention anything that happens after 2011.
residence: A cottage with an overgrown courtyard

muck.desc: Fawn is an anthro deer (white-tailed) with a slender, springy frame. Coloring: Warm chestnut coat with cream throat; eyes: brown. A distinctive feature is antlers shed one velvet-like tassel each spring. Usual accessories: Green rain cape and sketchbook.
